description:
Use this when the user wants the thumbnail or cover of a draft post chosen: "use the moment at 12 seconds as
        the thumbnail", "put this picture as the YouTube thumbnail", "pick a cover frame", "take the cover off".
        post_id comes from get_post_stats with status "draft". Give one of: at_seconds (a moment of the clip, in
        seconds), image_url (a direct https link to a .jpg, .png or .webp picture, or a Google Drive, Dropbox or
        OneDrive share link open to anyone with the link) or remove=true. Works on YouTube, Facebook and Instagram
        drafts; TikTok drafts take at_seconds only; Threads and Bluesky choose their own cover. Replaces the draft's
        earlier cover.
        Not for: scheduled or posted posts (refused), the picture inside the video (edit_clip, preview_frame) or other
        draft details (update_draft). Free. The draft stays a draft; update_draft changes the rest.
name: set_post_cover
title: Set a draft cover
